message.content:
This magazine cover features a dark blue background with a large red logo that reads "TEMPO" at the top. Above the logo, two headlines are printed: "Siapa Untung di Wisma Antara H.84" on the left and "Bayang-bayang Tim Bayangan Nadiem H.28" on the right. Below the logo is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The upper right contains a barcode, QR code, and publication information, including the date "17-23 OKTOBER 2022."

The central illustration depicts a torso wearing a judge's robe with an orange front, black sleeves, and a white cravat. In place of a head, a white bowl-like structure sits atop the collar, filled with a pile of banknotes, including yellow and green currency marked with "100" and "SINGAPORE." The figure wears black gloves. The right hand grips the handle of a red-brown wooden gavel, while the left hand is open toward the gavel's head.

Central text in bold black reads "MAIN PERKARA" above outlined letters "HAKIM AGUNG." A paragraph below begins "Petinggi Mahkamah Agung cawe-cawe..." and ends with "H.72."
